Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account

Class AccountController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.account.AccountController
All Implemented Interfaces:
AccountApi
@RestController public class AccountController extends Object implements AccountApi
Self-service account endpoints: registration, e-mail verification, password change and password reset. The paths, status codes and bodies are those of the contract apis/auth-server/rest-server/auth-server-api-v1.yaml, through the generated AccountApi. Failures are answered as RFC 9457 problem details by AccountExceptionHandler. No answer reveals whether an e-mail address belongs to an account.

    • requestPasswordReset

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> requestPasswordReset(PasswordResetRequest request)
      Asks for a password reset link. The answer is the same whether or not the address belongs to an account, and even when the link cannot be delivered: only a registered address is ever mailed, so a delivery failure must not tell the caller that the address is registered (the use case has rolled back its token by then).
      Specified by:
      requestPasswordReset in interface AccountApi
      Parameters:
      request - e-mail address of the account.
      Returns:
      202 Accepted.
